question: What is the relative ingest cost of visible exact-width source words and packed payloads when both routes produce the same D2/domain AST?
claim: The benchmark preflights exact AST parity and caller-supplied width boundaries, then measures only visible and packed readers. Width schedules remain out of the packed payload. This is not a self-describing file format, a language semantic proof, or a release speedup claim.
generation: inline exact-width corpus; 5 workloads; 32 paired warmups; 15 alternating samples with adaptive minimum 25 ms timing; caller-supplied widths excluded from packed payload
axis: visible vs packed p50/p90 ns/program; payload bytes and semantic bits
